description.es: Jaime le pregunta a Marta si le ha contado a Fina lo de su acuerdo. Marta le contesta con brusquedad y dice que no va a tener una relación con Fina. Luego se disculpa con Jaime. Dice que, con el mundo como está, una relación con Fina sería muy difícil, y que no quiere empezarla porque no quiere hacerle daño a Fina.
description.en: Jaime asks Marta whether she has told Fina about their arrangement. Marta snaps at Jaime and says she will not have a relationship with Fina. Then she apologizes to Jaime. She says that with the world the way it is, a relationship with Fina would be very hard, and that she does not want to start it because she does not want to hurt Fina.
